en: The image depicts a black-and-white photograph of ornately carved stone pillars, forming a colonnade within a temple structure. The intricate carvings include floral and geometric patterns, as well as figures, typical of South Asian temple architecture. The perspective looks down the length of the corridor, emphasizing the repeating columns. The text 'RAJ PITHRA'S TEMPLE' is visible in the lower left corner, and a small number '0396.0009' appears in the bottom right.
